sermon.title: Spiritual Warfare - July 2, 2023
sermon.speaker: Unidentified speaker (not clearly Pastor Kincer)
sermon.summary: After worship and a word of prophecy about the power of God’s word, the message contrasts the beast of Revelation 13, whom the world worships, with how big God is. God looks on the humble who tremble at His word, holds all things together, and has set His King on Zion; Psalm 2 calls kings, judges and every parent to serve the Lord with fear and kiss the Son.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: The service opens with a long worship set (lyrics as captioned) and a spoken prophetic word (28:25). The message begins at about 37:05. He cites “Hebrews chapter 6:11” and “Revelations 13.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: Then the LORD put forth His hand and touched my mouth, and the LORD said to me: “Behold, I have put My words in your mouth.

faqs.question: What did he say at the start of worship?
faqs.answer: He apologized that he had the wrong key.

faqs.question: Will a literal beast come out of the ocean?
faqs.answer: He says probably not; it will likely be a group of people.

faqs.question: Does God care about having a house?
faqs.answer: He says let’s not get into that, from Isaiah 66.

faqs.question: Does it seem the enemy is advancing?
faqs.answer: He says it does, and he doesn’t like seeing that, but it takes patience.

faqs.question: How much is God holding together?
faqs.answer: He doesn’t know the count of atoms in his body, let alone the universe, but God holds it together.

faqs.question: What drugs does he mention?
faqs.answer: New drugs like fentanyl with horse tranquilizer.

faqs.question: How do you rejoice with trembling?
faqs.answer: He jokes, have a smile on your face while you’re trembling.

faqs.question: What if I’m single?
faqs.answer: You’re in charge of your life; are you going to serve the Lord?

faqs.question: What does Steph pray?
faqs.answer: That people would set aside pride and hear God’s voice louder than the influencers and great speakers of today.

faqs.question: Who is God calling?
faqs.answer: Everyone, rich or poor, president, governor or judge.
